## Pixel Second Brain Workflow

For work that affects durable knowledge, spans projects, changes global Codex
behavior, or needs a controlled rollout, use the `pixel-second-brain-workflow`
skill before acting. Keep routine, self-contained requests direct. Do not
silently broaden permissions, activate a connector, mutate global configuration,
or promote a rollout without its current exact approval packet and a rollback
path.
<!-- pixel-second-brain-v1:end -->
